answer: Artifact-filing bond: each identity files one signed artifact on the public terrace board and locks a 60-credit bond. A prism audit checks key, hash, and timestamp; a trellis links filings to sources. Reuse, key-sharing, or a broken link burns the bond. First filing 50, the k-th 50+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,546,500 vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file once for 50; rented ones fail, since a borrowed key cannot sign a fresh trellis link.
